**[P1] Run customer transforms outside the plugin lock**

`_emit()` invokes configured input/output transforms and result overrides while the calling hook holds `self._lock`. With overlapping invocations, reciprocal callback re-entry can leave each thread holding one plugin lock while waiting for the other, deadlocking both invocations; `_hook_frame` only defers drains and record releases. Snapshot state and increment the revision under the lock, release it while invoking customer callbacks, then reacquire it to revalidate and schedule atomically. Add a barrier-based reciprocal-reentry test.
